facts.business: India Gelatine & Chemicals Limited manufactures and exports gelatine and allied products including ossein and di-calcium phosphate (DCP) for pharmaceutical, food, nutraceutical, cosmetic, and industrial applications.

capacity_or_capex.item: Property, Plant & Equipment and Capital Work-in-Progress

key_risks: Raw material consistency and pricing volatility
Global surplus production in South America and Turkey pressuring prices
Geopolitical tensions impacting LSHS availability and logistics costs
Regulatory compliance requirements (FDA, FSSAI, EU regulations)
Input cost fluctuations (Hydrochloric Acid, Lime, LSHS)
Reduction in selling prices affecting revenue
